notes.title: Added the game for April - Brave Little Pilot
Bug fixes and gameplay improvements
notes.content:
- Issue with VR being launched on game start should be solved
- Improved gameplay of Brave Little Dragon to reduce motion sickness
- Fixed issue with losing mouse control when switching levels
- Changed Brave Little Bear start area to reduce time running doing nothing at the start

notes.title: Brave Little Dragon - The Game for March
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E7tYMoVio-Y;full][/previewyoutube]



The goal is to collect all spheres, destroy the enemies 
and pass through the portals.

Your best time is saved to the leaderboards.


[i]There is a known bug that sometimes mouse loses focus to the game. Temporary workaround is to hold the right mouse button or restart the game. I am working on solving this issue and will release an update as soon as possible.[/i]
